LightningComponentBundle.description: Display customer orders in a tile format with order details and reorder functionality for B2B Commerce storefronts

property.name: accountId
property.label: Account ID
property.description: The Account ID to fetch orders for (leave blank to use current user's account)

property.name: webstoreId
property.label: Webstore ID
property.description: The B2B Commerce Webstore ID (required for reorder functionality)

property.name: maxOrders
property.label: Maximum Orders
property.description: Maximum number of orders to display

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Title displayed at the top of the component

property.name: showReorderButton
property.label: Show Reorder Button
property.description: Display the reorder button on each order tile

property.name: showViewDetailsButton
property.label: Show View Details Button
property.description: Display the view details button on each order tile
